title: Paul McCartney live: Nationwide Arena, Columbus | 2025
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Nationwide Arena in Columbus, Ohio, USA, on 8 November 2025.

It was the 14th show of the Got Back North American Tour 2025. The Got Back Tour lasted for 80 dates between April 2022 and November 2025.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).

McCartney previously performed at the Nationwide Arena on 13 October 2015 during the Out There Tour.
